wizards.name: Calculate Incidence
wizards.description: This wizard will calculate the incidence for a particular clinical condition. This calculation is done in SQL, and this works by finding the first instance of the condition (the diagnostic code) and determining if it occurs between a particular set of dates that you specify.
wizards.formNote: Note: this is a very rough approximation that is just a starting point for a more comprehensive analysis.

validation.message: Enter 1 or 2 of Height, Weight, and BMI.

wizards.name: Calculate Prevalence
wizards.description: This wizard will calculate the prevalence for a particular clinical condition. This calculation is done in SQL, and this works by finding the first instance of a condition.
wizards.formNote: Note: this is a very rough approximation that is just a starting point for a more comprehensive analysis.

validation.message: Enter 1 or 2 of Height, Weight, and BMI.

wizards.name: Calculate Mortality
wizards.description: This wizard will calculate the mortality rate for a particular clinical condition, and works by death dates that co-occur with a condition between a particular set of dates that you specify.
wizards.formNote: Note: this is a very rough approximation that is just a starting point for a more comprehensive analysis.

validation.message: Enter 1 or 2 of Height, Weight, and BMI.

wizards.name: Loss to Follow-up (LTFU)
wizards.description: This wizard will calculate the loss to follow-up rate for a particular clinical event, frequently used in clinical trial investigations and quality improvement research. This calculation works by finding patients who did not return for an expected visit within a time window you specify.

validation.message: Enter 1 or 2 of Height, Weight, and BMI.

wizards.name: 30-day readmission rate
wizards.description: This wizard will calculate the readmission rate for a particular clinical condition or event (e.g myocardial infarction or stroke) within a 30-day window after an initial discharge. The calculation will determine the number and percentage of patients who had a readmission within this fixed window period.
wizards.formNote: Note: this is a very rough approximation that is just a starting point for a more comprehensive analysis.

validation.message: Enter 1 or 2 of Height, Weight, and BMI.

groups.label: Vitals
groups.tooltip: Enter a single value, a comparison (e.g. >=140), or a range in brackets (e.g. [90-120]).

fields.label: Age Range
fields.tooltip: Enter a single age, a comparison (e.g. >=60), or a range in brackets (e.g. [50-80]).

wizards.name: Length of stay (LOS)
wizards.description: This wizard will calculate the length of stay for patients after a clinical event (e.g myocardial infarction, stroke, etc). This calculation consists of finding the number of days between admission and discharge for a condition you specify.
wizards.formNote: Note: this is a very rough approximation that is just a starting point for a more comprehensive analysis.

validation.message: Enter 1 or 2 of Height, Weight, and BMI.

groups.tooltip: Enter a single value, a comparison (e.g. >=140), or a range in brackets (e.g. [90-120]).
